name: leave
title: Leave request
description: Paid leave, sick leave or special leave, approved by the requester's manager, and by the head of the department too for more than five business days (fictional rules). Paid leave takes the days from the balance the leave book keeps

items.name: kind
items.text:
kind : choice "Kind of leave"
paid "Paid leave"
sick "Sick leave"
special "Special leave"

items.name: first_day
items.text: first_day : date "First day" range >=2026-01-01 <=2027-12-31 open in office

items.name: days
items.text: days : number "Business days" range >=1 <=20

items.name: back_on
items.text: back_on : date "Back at work on" = first_day + days business days in office

items.name: reason
items.text: reason : long text "Reason" count <=200 required when kind is special

items.name: cover
items.text: cover : person "Who covers for you" optional

items.name: submitted_by
items.text: submitted by everyone except team board

items.name: self_approval
items.text: self approval not allowed

items.name: same_approver
items.text: same approver approves once

items.name: send_back
items.text: send back to the requester, at most 2 times

items.name: comment_required
items.text: comment required for reject, send back

items.name: resubmit
items.text: resubmit within 5 business days

items.name: withdraw
items.text: withdraw until it is decided

items.name: hold_leave.take
items.text: on submitted hold leave.take(request: ticket.id, attempt: ticket.attempt, person: requester.id, days: days) when kind is paid

items.name: post_leave.take
items.text: on approved post leave.take(request: ticket.id, attempt: ticket.attempt) when kind is paid

items.name: void_leave.take
items.text: on sent back, rejected, withdrawn, expired void leave.take(request: ticket.id, attempt: ticket.attempt) when kind is paid

items.name: ends_in_time
items.text: ends_in_time : every ticket ends within 40 business days

items.name: a_long_paid_leave
items.text:
scenario a_long_paid_leave
requester e1203
given leave.grant(person: "e1203", year: "2026", days: 20)
form kind = paid, first_day = 2026-12-21, days = 8, reason = "A family visit"
| at | event | by | -> stage | status |
| 2026-11-16 09:00 | submit | e1203 | manager | in progress |
| 2026-11-16 17:00 | approve | e1101 | head | in progress |
| 2026-11-17 09:00 | remind | | head | in progress |
| 2026-11-19 00:00 | late | | head | in progress |
| 2026-11-19 10:00 | approve | e0101 | | approved |

items.name: a_leave_sent_back_with_a_comment
items.text:
scenario a_leave_sent_back_with_a_comment
requester e1203
given leave.grant(person: "e1203", year: "2026", days: 20)
form kind = paid, first_day = 2026-12-21, days = 3, reason = "A family visit"
| at | event | by | comment | -> stage | status |
| 2026-11-16 09:00 | submit | e1203 | | manager | in progress |
| 2026-11-16 11:00 | comment | e1101 | "Who covers for you while you are away?" | manager | in progress |
| 2026-11-16 13:00 | comment | e1203 | "e1201 does" | manager | in progress |
| 2026-11-16 17:00 | send back | e1101 | "Write e1201 as the cover, please" | | with requester |
| 2026-11-16 17:30 | comment | e1203 | "Where do I write the cover?" | | with requester |
| 2026-11-16 17:45 | comment | e1101 | "In the cover field of the form" | | with requester |
| 2026-11-17 09:00 | resubmit(cover: person "e1201") | e1203 | "e1201 is written as the cover" | manager | in progress |
| 2026-11-17 10:00 | approve | e1101 | "Have a good trip" | | approved |
